title: The Scholarship Opportunity Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Awards, eligibility, deadlines, award amounts, and application links. The Scholarship Opportunity Database lists individual scholarship awards as records: award amount, eligibility criteria, application deadline, required materials, and the official application link. Records are verified against the awarding organization's published page and carry verification dates, since deadlines pass and programs close. The Signature side adds eligibility-matching that filters awards against a student's profile.
capabilities: Record awards with amounts, eligibility, deadlines, and links
Verify each award against the official published page
Match awards to student profiles by eligibility
Track deadline calendars across all listed awards
Flag closed or changed programs for re-verification
